runner/src/classes.mjs.message: fix: align semantic model before v0 freeze

runner+schema: Pavlo's before-freeze fixes

1. Semantic edge is now claim- AND scope-specific: no global INDEPENDENT_RECOMPUTATION
   -> SEMANTIC_VERIFICATION upgrade (that would be the exact overclaim the linker catches).
   Recompute of claim C@scope S establishes semantic verification of C@S only.
2. Runner keeps oracle_pair / observed_pair / backend as three separate fields — pre-v18
   collapse now reports oracle=VIOLATED, observed=PRESERVED, backend=FAIL distinctly.
3. manifest.schema.json aligned with manifest-v0.md: structured Evidence type
   (authority_class + claim_type + scope) + issued_at XOR verification_time (no generic as_of).

runner: working zero-dep two-level evaluator + semantic linker

node runner/demo.mjs runs end-to-end: linker emits TYPE ERRORs with counterexamples;
two-level runner (pair outcome x backend conformance) reproduces the pre-v18 signed-
commitment collapse as a single FAIL + minimal witness; tampered fixtures read
VIOLATED pair / PASS backend on conforming adapters; pending backend stays CANNOT_CHECK.
